methodology: Sequential fresh browser per mode; baseline/current order alternates by repeat; median and min/max use same-mode runs. All runs must exactly match the first baseline inputs, geometry/tracking controls except the explicitly recorded cache policy, measured-observation hash, finite-model hashes and cohort evaluation.

videoWindow.timing: resampled 10 fps analysis frames after seek; no physical velocity inferred
videoWindow.calibration: assumed focal 0.8 * analysis width; not calibrated or ground truth

calibration.name: user-video-window
calibration.source: assumed focal 0.8 * analysis width; not calibrated or ground truth

limitations: Adapter metadata is reported without independent physical-device verification. Browser stage totals exclude browser startup/transport and synthetic fixture generation; video preparation is separate. Cached Graham Hall detector/matcher costs are excluded. Read/upload counts are application/Resident counters, not physical bus bytes. Faster execution does not establish accuracy beyond the declared input conditions.

depth.reference: nearest rendered pixel depth; quantization and boundaries included

pose.alignment: one fixed truth seed gauge per map; no per-frame alignment

cohortComparison.limitation: observation ownership establishes evaluation correspondence, not global physical identity; no truth positions enter reconstruction
